primary_metric: measurement SYN answered (SYN/ACK or RST), paired precondition versus matched no-precondition control

limit.note: one token per 500 ms; SYNs without a token are dropped

gates.go_rule: cross-port classification accuracy over all planned studies has a two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound above the upper bound of the matched isolated-control classification accuracy
gates.confounded_location: shared-endpoint and shared-path must not be assigned different locations without an orthogonal signal that distinguishes them

limitations: All namespaces share one Linux kernel inside one Docker VM; study repetitions are not independent hosts.
Limiters are iptables limit-module token buckets; other shared-state mechanisms are not represented.
The isolated baseline reuses the experiments' own no-precondition probes; it is matched in timing and port, not a separate scanner.
Unresolved and failed studies stay in every denominator.
